newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA JAN-SEPT RETAIL SALES RISE 1.0 PCT YR/YR.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA JAN-SEPT RETAIL SALES RISE 1.0 PCT YR/YR.

text.p: Bulgarian retail sales in the first nine months of this year were a real 1.0 percent higher than a year earlier, National Statistical Institute (NSI) figures show.
BULGARIA RETAIL SALES JAN-SEPT JAN-AUG JAN-SEPT '95
However, retail sales in September alone fell by a real 4.7
percent from the same month of last year to 88.5 billion levs
Cumulative consumer price inflation for the first nine
months was 153 percent, up from 23.2 percent for the same
The Bulgarian lev fell to around 220 at the end of
September from 70 at the beginning of the year.
